@@ -704,3 +704,27 @@ func TestStreamResponse_Usage(t *testing.T) {
 	require.NotNil(t, usage)
 	assert.Equal(t, llm.Usage{PromptTokens: 50, CompletionTokens: 15, TotalTokens: 65, CachedPromptTokens: 20, ReasoningTokens: 5}, *usage)
 }
+
+// An error sent after the 200 status must fail the stream, even when text has
+// already arrived.
+func TestStreamResponse_Error(t *testing.T) {
+	t.Parallel()
+
+	stream := `data: {"candidates":[{"content":{"parts":[{"text":"partial"}]}}]}` + "\n\n" +
+		`data: {"error":{"code":503,"message":"upstream overloaded"}}` + "\n\n"
+
+	provider := &Provider{}
+	events := make(chan llm.StreamEvent)
+	go provider.streamResponse(context.Background(), io.NopCloser(strings.NewReader(stream)), events)
+
+	var got []llm.StreamEvent
+	for event := range events {
+		got = append(got, event)
+	}
+
+	require.Len(t, got, 2)
+	assert.Equal(t, "partial", got[0].Delta)
+	assert.True(t, got[1].Done)
+	require.ErrorContains(t, got[1].Error, "upstream overloaded")
+	assert.True(t, llm.IsRetryable(got[1].Error))
+}

+// Copyright (C) 2026 Yota Hamada

+
+package llm_test
+
+import (
+	"encoding/json"
+	"testing"
+
+	"github.com/dagucloud/dagu/v2/internal/llm"
+	"github.com/stretchr/testify/assert"
+)
+
+func TestStreamError(t *testing.T) {
+	t.Parallel()
+
+	for _, raw := range []string{"", "null", `""`} {
+		assert.NoError(t, llm.StreamError("openai", json.RawMessage(raw)), "raw %q", raw)
+	}
+
+	// OpenAI sends string codes, and some local servers send a bare string.
+	// Without a numeric status, the error is retried.
+	for provider, raw := range map[string]string{
+		"openai": `{"code":"server_error","message":"boom"}`,
+		"local":  `"boom"`,
+	} {
+		err := llm.StreamError(provider, json.RawMessage(raw))
+		assert.EqualError(t, err, llm.NewAPIError(provider, 0, "boom").Error())
+		assert.True(t, llm.IsRetryable(err), "raw %s", raw)
+	}
+
+	// A numeric client error code is not retried.
+	assert.False(t, llm.IsRetryable(
+		llm.StreamError("gemini", json.RawMessage(`{"code":400,"message":"bad"}`))))
+}
